description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionController' for managing employee US tax exemption data within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base view controller, utilizes services to fetch country and province data, and prepares Vue.js components with relevant properties for rendering tax exemption information for an employee.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the tax exemption view for US employees within the HRM system, establishing necessary data and permissions for the employee tax exemption UI component.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Returns the CountryService instance used for fetching country-related data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component properties before rendering the view, based on the employee number extracted from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Provides data group identifiers used when checking user capabilities related to tax exemptions.
